#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail

CF="{{compose_file}}"
TIMEOUT={{timeout_seconds}}

docker compose -f "$CF" up -d

start=$(date +%s)
while :; do
  unhealthy=$(docker compose -f "$CF" ps --format json \
    | jq -r 'select(.Health!="" and .Health!="healthy") | .Name')
  [ -z "$unhealthy" ] && { echo "all healthy"; exit 0; }
  now=$(date +%s)
  if [ $((now - start)) -gt "$TIMEOUT" ]; then
    echo "timeout, still unhealthy:"; echo "$unhealthy"; exit 1
  fi
  echo "waiting: $(echo $unhealthy | tr '\n' ' ')"
  sleep 2
done
summary_zh: compose up 後輪詢等所有服務 healthy
